Class DailyLimitService

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.service.DailyLimitService
@Service public class DailyLimitService extends Object
Enforces and books the daily CUD budget of an entity or pseudo entity name.

It holds what DailyLimitUpdCreateLogger used to implement itself. The logic moved here because the budget is not only consumed by REST controllers: bulk write paths live in repository implementations and services, which cannot reach the protected methods of an abstract controller base class. The controller base class now delegates, so a single-row create through UpdateCreate and a bulk upload are accounted the same way.

Which users a budget applies to is entirely a matter of configuration. EntityLimitService resolves a row written for the user, then one for the user's most privileged role, then the default row of the key; no row at all means unlimited. There is no hardcoded restriction to ROLE_LIMITEDIT.

  • Method Details

    • check

      public void check(User user, String entityName, int additional)
      Checks whether a number of further operations still fits into today's budget of an entity, and throws before the first row is written when it does not.

      The whole request is rejected as one unit: a bulk upload that would cross the budget writes nothing at all rather than stopping halfway through. The limit is resolved independently of the counter row, so a missing counter row counts as 0 rather than skipping the check.

      Parameters:
      user - the user performing the operation, whose id the counter is kept under
      entityName - entity or pseudo entity name the budget is configured for
      additional - how many units this operation costs; a value below one is treated as one
      Throws:
      LimitEntityTransactionException - when the budget is configured and would be exceeded

    • log

      public void log(Integer idUser, String entityName, OperationType operationType, int count)
      Books a number of performed operations on today's counter of an entity.
      Parameters:
      idUser - the user who performed the operation
      entityName - entity or pseudo entity name the counter is kept under
      operationType - which of the three counters is raised
      count - how many units to book; a value below one is treated as one
